I’m testing the documented retry pattern with `Assigned` replies dropped to see whether a retry duplicates the committed entry.

item.text:
The audit now has 18 confirmed findings. The latest addition is a runtime API correctness issue:

- **`AppendError::Timeout` is not retry-safe.** With `Assigned` replies dropped, two retries following the documented contract both returned `Timeout`, yet the leader’s decided log contained two identical entries. Timeout removes only local tracking and does not cancel an already-forwarded proposal: [audit_timeout_retry.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos_runtime/tests/audit_timeout_retry.rs).

Additional completed checks:

- The persistent corruption was confirmed through direct `append_entries` use and remains visible after closing and reopening RocksDB.
- A 5,000-step randomized crash run completed 18 crashes and 2,488 proposals without decided-prefix conflict.
- Default workspace compilation passes.
- All shipped runtime tests pass under both normal and `--all-features` configurations.
- The audit added no changes to captured implementation code; all tests and diagnostics remain separate.

Full evidence and commands: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
